name: share-simple
description: Simple ladder for share/export: open the share modal, verify copy-link UI renders, verify shareExport flag is ON in Simple mode. Confirms the 3D link, plan link, Snapshot PNG and PDF export buttons are present. Tests that pro-only share features (report, boq) are hidden in Simple mode.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-shareexport-flag-on-simple
steps.failMessage: shareExport flag is OFF in Simple mode — expected ON (simple-tier)

steps.name: share-modal-visible
steps.failMessage: Share modal (.modal-overlay) did not appear after setShareOpen(true)

steps.name: verify-copy-3d-link-button
